tools.name: searchLangfuseDocs
tools.description: Semantic search (RAG) over the Langfuse documentation. Use this whenever the user asks a broader question that cannot be answered by a specific single page. Returns the text of the most relevant docs pages, with their URLs. For prices, call getLangfuseDocsPage with /pricing or /pricing-self-host. Pr

tools.name: getLangfuseDocsPage
tools.description: Fetch the raw Markdown for a single Langfuse docs page. Accepts a docs path (e.g., /docs/observability/overview) or a full https://langfuse.com URL. Returns the exact Markdown (may include front matter). Use when you need a specific page content (Integration, Features, API, etc.) or code samples. Pr

tools.name: getLangfuseOverview
tools.description: Get a high-level, machine-readable index by downloading https://langfuse.com/llms.txt. Use this at the start of a session when needed to discover key docs endpoints or to seed follow-up calls to searchLangfuseDocs or getLangfuseDocsPage. Returns the plain text contents of llms.txt. findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "submitFeedback" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Submit explicit user-approved feedback to the Langfuse team. Before calling, ask permission and show the exact payload. If the user wants a reply, ask them to i…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "submitFeedback" references sensitive artifacts (credentials, secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: searchLangfuseDocs, getLangfuseDocsPage · Private data: submitFeedback · Public sink: submitFeedback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: searchLangfuseDocs, getLangfuseDocsPage · Private data: submitFeedback · Public sink: submitFeedback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
